project.name: ECU Service Lab — Automotive Module Compatibility & Repair Service Platform
project.source: PRD - Automotive Module Compatibility & Repair Service.md (revised for Next.js + Prisma + Supabase + Vercel)

stack.app: Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript — one app for the public wizard, admin panel and API
stack.data: Prisma ORM on Supabase PostgreSQL (pooled connection for runtime, direct connection for migrations)
stack.auth: Supabase Auth (email/password), admin only, checked in middleware.ts and in every admin Server Action
stack.files: Vercel Blob with client uploads through signed tokens
stack.payments: Stripe Node SDK — Payment Links + webhook Route Handler

project.scope: Core MVP only (PRD sections 3–10). Excluded: every future-phase item in PRD section 11, plus the optional items in section 12 (cancelled status, revert to pending review, photo hints, a separate staging database).

conventions.money: Integer cents in the database and server code; format as dollars only in the UI
conventions.statuses: pending_review, awaiting_payment, payment_received, block_received, in_progress, ready_shipped_back, completed
conventions.mutations: Server Actions for in-app forms and admin mutations; Route Handlers only for the Stripe webhook and the Blob upload token
conventions.business_rules: Pure functions in /lib/domain; Server Actions do the Prisma calls and orchestration
conventions.validation: Every Server Action and Route Handler validates its input with zod on the server
conventions.language: All code, comments, commit messages and docs in English

before_start: Read this file and run git log --oneline -20
Pick ONE task with status pending and the highest priority
Check that every task in its dependencies has status done
during_work: Work only on the selected task
Do not touch code unrelated to the current task
Schema changes go only through prisma/schema.prisma plus a new migration from prisma migrate dev; never edit an applied migration, and never use db push outside throwaway local prototyping
Never trust price, match or status data sent from the client — recompute it on the server
before_finish: Set status to done by editing tasks.json directly — change only the status field of the completed task, no validation scripts

Add ONE line to progress.md: '## YYYY-MM-DD — TASK-XXX: <name>
- <what was done in 1–2 sentences>'
FORBIDDEN: creating scratch/temp files (tasks_scratch.json, progress_old.md, etc.) — all edits go directly to the target file
FORBIDDEN: deleting or editing tasks other than changing their status
optimization_rules: No temporary files: never create files like tasks_scratch.json or progress_old.md; update target files in a single clean operation
Ultra-short progress.md: each entry is strictly 1–2 lines — no essays, no walls of text
Fast status updates: change task status directly via a simple JSON edit; skip multi-step script validations
Spend context on code and functionality, not paperwork and bureaucratic logs

tasks.description: Scaffold the Next.js app: App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, folder layout and typed env config
acceptance_criteria: create-next-app with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind and ESLint; shadcn/ui initialized in /components/ui with Button, Input, Select, Card, Dialog, Table, Badge, Form and Sonner
The folders from PRD section 7 exist: app/(public), app/admin, app/api, lib/{domain,actions,email}, components/{ui,wizard,admin}, prisma

/lib/env.ts parses all server env vars with zod (DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, Supabase keys, BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN, Stripe keys, RESEND_API_KEY, ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL) and fails fast when one is missing
.env.example lists every variable; .env* files are git-ignored; npm run build passes

tasks.description: Connect Prisma to Supabase Postgres and add the Prisma client singleton
acceptance_criteria: schema.prisma datasource uses DATABASE_URL (the Supabase transaction pooler, with ?pgbouncer=true) and directUrl = DIRECT_URL for migrations
/lib/db.ts exports a global-cached PrismaClient that is not recreated on hot reload and is marked server-only
The package.json build script runs prisma generate; postinstall runs prisma generate

tasks.description: Prisma models and migration for the reference data: Vehicle, ModuleCategory, PriceTier, Service, CompatibilityEntry, CompatibilityService
acceptance_criteria: Models match PRD section 6, with @@map to snake_case table names, BigInt autoincrement ids, @db.VarChar sizes and Timestamptz timestamps
@@unique([make, model, year]) on Vehicle; @@unique([vehicleId, categoryId, partNumber]) on CompatibilityEntry for exact-match lookup
CompatibilityService has a composite @@id([entryId, serviceId]); Service.priceTier is a relation to PriceTier.tierCode
EntrySource enum (import, admin_confirmed); amountCents is Int
prisma migrate dev creates the migration without errors

tasks.description: Prisma models and migration for orders: Order, OrderPhoto, OrderAnswer, OrderStatusHistory
acceptance_criteria: Order has every field from PRD section 6, plus returnTrackingNo (for email #4), paymentLinkUrl and a unique idempotencyKey (blocks duplicate submits)
OrderStatus enum with the 7 statuses; PhotoType enum (sticker, donor, original)
trackingToken is @unique; indexes on status, customerEmail, partNumberEntered and createdAt
Price snapshot fields are Int? in cents, null until the order is matched

tasks.description: Prisma models and migration for support tables: AppSetting, QuestionDefinition, StripeEvent, EmailLog
acceptance_criteria: AppSetting (key/value) holds return_shipping_fee_cents
QuestionDefinition: questionSetCode, questionCode, label, answerType enum (text, yes_no, textarea, photo), required, sortOrder; unique (questionSetCode, questionCode)
StripeEvent uses the Stripe event id as primary key (webhook idempotency)
EmailLog stores orderId, emailType, status, error and sentAt, with a unique (orderId, emailType) so each email is sent only once

tasks.description: Block the Supabase Data API from reading app tables
acceptance_criteria: A SQL migration enables Row Level Security on every app table, with no policies, so the anon and authenticated keys cannot read or write them through PostgREST
All data access goes through Prisma on the server (the connection role bypasses RLS); the Supabase client is used only for auth
The Supabase service role key is used only in server code and never exposed through a NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable

tasks.description: Prisma seed script for reference data plus optional sample compatibility data
acceptance_criteria: prisma/seed.ts is idempotent (upsert) and registered in package.json
Seeds the 5 module categories, tiers 100/200/300/400, services with questionSetCode, the return shipping fee, and the SRS, CLONING, VIN_WRITE, RESTORATION and FOLLOW_UP question sets from PRD 4.4
Sample compatibility entries (a few makes and categories, one entry with zero services) are inserted only when SEED_SAMPLE=true

tasks.description: Connect the Vercel project and deploy a hello-world build
acceptance_criteria: The repo is connected to Vercel; main deploys to production and branches get preview deployments
Env vars are set in Vercel for Production and Preview; a Vercel Blob store is linked to the project
The build runs prisma migrate deploy before next build (production only)
The production URL renders the home page and a server-rendered DB read succeeds

tasks.description: Domain rules: status transitions and the tracking token (/lib/domain)
acceptance_criteria: /lib/domain/status.ts exports the allowed-transitions map (pending_review → awaiting_payment → payment_received → block_received → in_progress → ready_shipped_back → completed), canTransition() and nextStatuses()
/lib/domain/token.ts generates a tracking token from 32 random bytes (crypto.randomBytes), base64url-encoded
Status labels and colors for the UI are in /lib/constants.ts
No Prisma, Next.js or Stripe imports in /lib/domain

tasks.description: Domain rules: part number normalization, compatibility decision and price quote
acceptance_criteria: normalizePartNumber() does trim + uppercase only; there is never fuzzy matching
decideMatch(entry, services) returns matched only when the entry exists and has at least one linked service
quote(tierAmountCents, returnFeeCents) returns {servicePriceCents, returnShippingFeeCents, totalCents}
Pure functions with no framework imports

tasks.description: Order status service: the single place that changes orders.status
acceptance_criteria: /lib/services/order-status.ts exports advanceOrderStatus(orderId, to, changedBy, extra?), which validates the transition with /lib/domain/status and updates the order plus a history row in one Prisma transaction
After the commit it runs registered side effects keyed by target status (the payment-link and email tasks plug in here); a failed side effect is logged and never rolls back the status
A codebase search shows no other code writing order.status

tasks.description: Supabase Auth for the admin: SSR clients, middleware, login and logout, requireAdmin helper
acceptance_criteria: @supabase/ssr server and browser clients live in /lib/supabase
middleware.ts refreshes the session and redirects any /admin/* request (except /admin/login) to login when there is no user
The /admin/login page (shadcn form) signs in with email/password; a logout action signs out
requireAdmin() is callable from Server Actions and Route Handlers and throws when there is no session
Public sign-ups are disabled in Supabase; README explains creating the admin in the Supabase dashboard

tasks.description: Admin layout shell
acceptance_criteria: app/admin/layout.tsx checks the session server-side and renders the navigation: Orders, Review Queue, Compatibility, Pricing, plus Log out
Placeholder pages exist for each nav item; the layout is responsive (collapsible nav on mobile)

tasks.description: Vercel Blob upload token Route Handler with server-side validation
acceptance_criteria: app/api/uploads/token/route.ts uses handleUpload from @vercel/blob/client
onBeforeGenerateToken sets allowedContentTypes (image/jpeg, image/png, image/heic, image/webp; plus application/pdf for labels), maximumSizeInBytes (10 MB) and addRandomSuffix: true
Purpose comes from the client payload: 'wizard' is allowed publicly under the pending/ path prefix; 'label' requires requireAdmin()
The client never gets a general-purpose token; uploaded URLs are validated server-side as Vercel Blob URLs before they are saved to the database

tasks.description: Wizard shell: shared state, step indicator and layout for /order/*
acceptance_criteria: A client-side wizard store (React context or zustand) persisted to sessionStorage holds vehicle, category, partNumber, sticker upload, match result, service, answers and contact details
The StepIndicator component in /components/wizard shows the steps and the current one
app/(public)/order/layout.tsx renders the indicator; the landing page links to /order/vehicle
Mobile-first layout

tasks.description: /order/vehicle — cascading Make → Model → Year selection
acceptance_criteria: The page (a Server Component) loads makes that have at least one compatibility entry
Server Actions getModels(make) and getYears(make, model) return only values with entries; selecting a parent resets its children
Next is disabled until make, model and year are all chosen

tasks.description: /order/module — module category selection
acceptance_criteria: The 5 categories render as selectable cards with icons
Next is disabled until a category is chosen

tasks.description: /order/compatibility — Part Number, sticker photo upload and the checkCompatibility Server Action
acceptance_criteria: Part Number is required, with helper text that it is the catalog number, not the serial number; a reference sticker image sits next to the upload
The FileUpload component in /components/wizard uploads directly to Blob through the token route, shows a preview and progress, and blocks Continue until the upload completes
checkCompatibility (zod-validated) returns {matched, entryId, services: [{id, name, priceCents}]} computed with /lib/domain
Match → /order/service. No match → a notice that the part will be reviewed manually, then /order/details with service selection skipped

tasks.description: /order/service — pick one confirmed service
acceptance_criteria: Shows only the services from the match result, as radio cards with name and formatted price
Exactly one can be chosen; Next is disabled until one is selected

tasks.description: /order/details — required description plus the data-driven dynamic questions
acceptance_criteria: The description textarea is always required
The getQuestions(serviceId) Server Action returns the service's question set, plus FOLLOW_UP when applicable
One DynamicQuestion component renders the text, yes_no, textarea and photo types; photo answers (cloning: original and donor) use FileUpload
Required questions show inline errors and block Next; the pending-review path shows only the description

tasks.description: /order/shipping — contact details, return address and order review
acceptance_criteria: shadcn Form + react-hook-form + zod: name, email, phone, street, city, state (default HI), ZIP (US format) — all required

The review section shows every entered value with Edit links. Matched orders show service price + return shipping = total from a getQuote Server Action; pending-review orders say the price will be confirmed after review
States that inbound shipping is free, and that no payment is taken now because the Stripe link arrives by email

tasks.description: placeOrder Server Action — the matched path and the pending-review path
acceptance_criteria: Validates the full payload with zod, including the required answers for the service's question set and that photo URLs are from Blob
Re-runs the compatibility check on the server; the client's match result is ignored
Matched: snapshots the quote and creates the order, then calls advanceOrderStatus to awaiting_payment. Not matched: creates it as pending_review with service, matched entry and prices null
Order, photos, answers and the first history row are written in one prisma.$transaction
The idempotency key is generated once per wizard session; a repeat submit returns the existing order. Returns {orderNumber, trackingToken, status}

tasks.description: /order/confirmation — screen after submit
acceptance_criteria: Shows the order number and a copyable tracking link (/track/[token])
Text differs by path: 'check your email for the payment link' (matched) or 'your part is being reviewed' (pending review)
Cloning orders list in plain language which modules to ship
Wizard state is cleared from sessionStorage

tasks.description: Wizard step guards
acceptance_criteria: Each step redirects to the first incomplete step when earlier wizard state is missing
/order/service redirects to /order/compatibility unless the store holds a successful match
Deep-linking or using browser back/forward never shows a step with inconsistent state

tasks.description: Stripe client wrapper and createPaymentLink
acceptance_criteria: /lib/stripe.ts exports a server-only Stripe client using STRIPE_SECRET_KEY

createPaymentLink(order) creates a Payment Link with two USD line items (service, return shipping) built from the order's cent snapshots, with metadata orderId and trackingToken, and after_completion redirecting to /track/[token]
Test mode and live mode are selected only by the key

tasks.description: Payment gate: create the payment link when an order enters awaiting_payment
acceptance_criteria: Registered as the awaiting_payment side effect in the order status service
Refuses orders that are not in awaiting_payment or have no price snapshot
Saves stripePaymentLinkId and paymentLinkUrl; if a link already exists it is reused, never duplicated
A regeneratePaymentLink admin action (requireAdmin) retries after a Stripe failure

tasks.description: Stripe webhook Route Handler
acceptance_criteria: app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts reads the raw body (await req.text()) and verifies it with stripe.webhooks.constructEvent and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET; an invalid signature returns 400
Inserts the event id into StripeEvent first; a duplicate returns 200 with no side effects
checkout.session.completed with metadata.orderId sets stripePaymentStatus and calls advanceOrderStatus to payment_received with changedBy 'system'
Unknown events return 200 and are ignored; the route runs on the Node.js runtime

tasks.description: /track/[token] — public tracking page
acceptance_criteria: A Server Component looks up the order only by token and shows the order number, vehicle, module, service, totals and a status timeline of all stages with dates from the history
No email, phone, address or photos are shown
An unknown token renders notFound() with a generic message
An unpaid order in awaiting_payment shows a Pay now button linking to paymentLinkUrl

tasks.description: Post-payment materials on the tracking page: packing instructions, printable order slip, return label
acceptance_criteria: Shown only when status is payment_received or later
/track/[token]/slip has print CSS and shows the order number, modules to ship and the shop address, with a Print button
The label download link appears only when shippingLabelUrl is set

tasks.description: /admin/orders — filterable orders table
acceptance_criteria: A Server Component reads filters from searchParams (status, q for order number/email/part number, dateFrom, dateTo, page) and queries Prisma with pagination, newest first
Client filter controls update the URL; the shadcn Table shows status badges and totals
Clicking a row opens /admin/orders/[id]

tasks.description: /admin/orders/[id] — order detail
acceptance_criteria: Shows vehicle, module, part number, service, answers (labeled with the question text), contacts and address, price breakdown, Stripe status and link, and the status history timeline
Photos render as thumbnails with a Dialog lightbox
Shows a Regenerate payment link button when an awaiting_payment order has no link

tasks.description: Admin manual status update
acceptance_criteria: An updateOrderStatus Server Action (requireAdmin, zod) calls advanceOrderStatus with the admin's email as changedBy
The select on the detail page offers only nextStatuses(); pending_review → awaiting_payment is never offered here
Moving to ready_shipped_back shows an optional return tracking number field
Includes a confirm dialog, a toast on success and a refreshed history (revalidatePath)

tasks.description: Admin return label upload, replace and remove
acceptance_criteria: The detail page uploads a pdf or image through the token route with purpose 'label' (admin-only)
setShippingLabel and removeShippingLabel Server Actions (requireAdmin) update shippingLabelUrl; replacing deletes the old blob with del()
The label then appears on the tracking page

tasks.description: Admin customer history by email
acceptance_criteria: The customer email on the detail page links to /admin/orders?email=…
The orders page supports an exact, case-insensitive email filter and shows order count and total paid for that email

tasks.description: /admin/review-queue — pending_review worklist
acceptance_criteria: Lists pending_review orders oldest first as cards (ReviewQueueCard) with sticker photo, part number, vehicle, category and description
The admin nav shows a badge with the pending count, loaded server-side in the layout

tasks.description: confirmCompatibility Server Action
acceptance_criteria: requireAdmin plus zod: orderId, supportedServiceIds[] (services of the order's category) and selectedServiceId, which must be one of the supported ones
In one transaction: upsert the CompatibilityEntry (source admin_confirmed), replace its service links, set matchedEntryId and serviceId, and snapshot the quote
Then calls advanceOrderStatus to awaiting_payment, which triggers the payment link
Rejects orders not in pending_review; this is the only path from pending_review to awaiting_payment. The next order with the same part number matches automatically

tasks.description: Confirm-compatibility dialog in the review queue
acceptance_criteria: A card opens a Dialog with the enlarged photo, part number and vehicle
Checkboxes select the supported services of the category; a select picks this order's service from the checked ones
Submit calls confirmCompatibility, shows errors inline, and on success closes, shows a toast and revalidates the queue and badge

tasks.description: /admin/compatibility — read-only searchable compatibility database
acceptance_criteria: Server-side search by part number and filters on make, category and source, via searchParams, with pagination
The table shows Make, Model, Year, Category, Part Number, services (badges) and source

tasks.description: Excel/CSV import Server Actions: preview and apply
acceptance_criteria: Accepts both .xlsx (via xlsx/exceljs) and .csv (via papaparse); the canonical Excel column format is: Make, Model, Year, Category (must match a seeded category name), Part Number, and one column per service name (value '1' or 'x' = supported, empty = not)

previewImport(file) (requireAdmin) parses the file and returns valid rows and error rows with reasons (unknown category, unknown service column, empty part number, invalid year) without writing anything

applyImport(rows) re-validates on the server, then upserts vehicles, entries (source import) and service links in batched transactions without duplicates, and returns counts of added, updated and skipped
Column matching is case-insensitive and trims whitespace; unknown extra columns are ignored with a warning

tasks.description: Excel/CSV import screen with preview
acceptance_criteria: /admin/compatibility/import has a file picker (accepts .xlsx and .csv), a preview table with error rows highlighted and their reasons, and an Apply button enabled only when valid rows exist
Shows the result counts after apply and revalidates the compatibility list

tasks.description: Resend setup, email templates and the send helper
acceptance_criteria: /lib/email/send.ts wraps the Resend SDK: sendOrderEmail(orderId, type) renders the template, sends it, and records the result in EmailLog; the unique (orderId, emailType) key prevents duplicates
The 5 PRD emails are React Email (or plain TSX) templates in /lib/email/templates
Sending happens after the DB commit; a failure is logged and never breaks the user action

tasks.description: Emails #1 (customer: order submitted) and #5 (admin: new order)
acceptance_criteria: Both are sent from placeOrder after a successful commit, for both paths
#1 has the order number, tracking link and next steps specific to the path
#5 goes to ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL with the order number, contact details, part number, sticker photo and a link to /admin/orders/[id]

tasks.description: Emails #2 (payment link), #3 (module received) and #4 (ready / shipped back)
acceptance_criteria: #2 is sent right after the payment link is saved, with the order summary, price breakdown and link
#3 is registered as the block_received side effect; #4 as the ready_shipped_back side effect, including returnTrackingNo if set
No email for payment_received, in_progress or completed

tasks.description: /admin/pricing — tier amounts, service-to-tier mapping and return shipping fee
acceptance_criteria: Server Actions (requireAdmin, zod) updateTierAmount, setServiceTier and setReturnShippingFee, with validation (amount > 0, fee between $20 and $30)
The page edits values in dollars and stores cents; a toast confirms each save
Only new quotes are affected; existing order snapshots stay unchanged

tasks.description: Security pass before launch
acceptance_criteria: Every admin Server Action calls requireAdmin() itself, not only through middleware, because Server Actions are publicly reachable endpoints
Security headers are set in next.config (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, frame-ancestors 'none')
Vercel Firewall rate-limit rules cover the public Server Actions (checkCompatibility, placeOrder), the upload token route and /track/*
No PII, tokens or secrets in logs or error messages; all server-only modules import 'server-only'

tasks.description: Production launch configuration
acceptance_criteria: The custom domain is added in Vercel and NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL points to it
Live Stripe keys and the webhook secret are set; the production webhook endpoint is registered in Stripe for checkout.session.completed
The Resend sending domain is verified (SPF/DKIM)
The Supabase plan is chosen with backups enabled (a paid tier for daily backups), and the decision is recorded in README
The real compatibility dataset is imported through the admin Excel import; no sample seed data in production
